origin: OpenCode 1.18.16 request whose prompt is in Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, with emoji and combining marks; the relay answers in the same, with the multi-byte characters split across the pieces of the stream. The capture asks for a Claude model; the model is changed to gpt-5.5 and reasoning_effort is the medium OpenCode sends for it (its verbosity field is left out, see extra-opencode-gpt-request-with-verbosity). The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
